title: Talos pipeline parameters
description: Nextflow configuration parameters for the Talos pipeline.

input_tsv.description: Input runs as a TSV of `cohort`, `path`, and `type`

aargus_metadata_spec.description: Optional complete JSON override for configured source identity.

processed_annotations.description: Global output directories - should be changed for each deployment.

ref_genome.description: Reference genome, default is in large_files.

container.description: Optional container image used by processes when running with a container-enabled profile.

mane.description: MANE transcript resource, default is in large_files.

mane_json.description: Result file from running ParseManeIntoJson on the MANE summary file, default is in processed_annotations.

mane_version.description: Explicit mane resource release or snapshot identifier.

ensembl_gff.description: Ensembl gene feature file, default is in large_files.

ensembl_bed.description: Result files from the CreateRoiFromGff3 nextflow module, default is in processed_annotations.

ensembl_merged_bed.description: Result files (merged bed) from the CreateRoiFromGff3 nextflow module, default is in processed_annotations.

ensembl_version.description: Explicit ensembl resource release or snapshot identifier.

alphamissense_tsv.description: AlphaMissense raw data, default is in large_files.

alphamissense_zip.description: AlphaMissense reformatted as an echtvar-compatible zip, default is in processed_annotations.

alphamissense_version.description: Explicit alphamissense resource release or snapshot identifier.

mitimpact_version.description: Explicit mitimpact resource release or snapshot identifier.

mitotip_version.description: Explicit mitotip resource release or snapshot identifier.

napogee_version.description: Explicit napogee resource release or snapshot identifier.

submission_summary.description: ClinVar download URL for submission summary.

variant_summary.description: ClinVar download URL for variant summary.

clinvar_version.description: ClinVar and PM5 preparation snapshot, defaulting to the current year-month (yyyy-MM).

hpo.description: HPO and Phenotype file, default is in large_files.

hpo_version.description: Explicit hpo resource release or snapshot identifier.

gen2phen.description: Genes to phenotype file, default is in large_files.

gen2phen_version.description: Explicit gen2phen resource release or snapshot identifier.

phenio_db.description: Phenio database, default is in large_files.

phenio_version.description: Explicit phenio resource release or snapshot identifier.

input_vcf_extension.description: Input VCF extension and location logic.

vcf_split_n.description: Number of lines to split VCFs by.

gnomad_zip.description: Echtvar-formatted annotation data for gnomAD, default is in large_files.

gnomad_version.description: Explicit gnomad resource release or snapshot identifier.

spliceai_mode.description: SpliceAI annotation mode. When null, spliceai_enabled selects precomputed or disabled.

spliceai_enabled.description: Compatibility fallback used when spliceai_mode is null.

spliceai_vcf.description: Precomputed SpliceAI VCF, required in precomputed mode, with a .tbi or .csi index.

spliceai_version.description: Explicit spliceai resource release or snapshot identifier.

fastspliceai_bin.description: FastSpliceAI executable, required in fastspliceai and fastspliceai_cache modes.

fastspliceai_reference.description: FastSpliceAI reference FASTA with a .fai index. Defaults to ref_genome when unset.

fastspliceai_reference_version.description: Explicit fastspliceai_reference resource release or snapshot identifier.

fastspliceai_annotation.description: Transcript table for fastspliceai_cache mode. Defaults to the bundled MANE v1.5 table; null uses packaged GRCh38 annotations. fastspliceai mode always uses packaged GRCh38 annotations.

fastspliceai_annotation_version.description: Explicit fastspliceai_annotation resource release or snapshot identifier.

fastspliceai_cache.description: Mutable annotation cache path, required in fastspliceai_cache mode.
